question_stem:
A student investigates the relationship between the luminosity of a star and its mass.
The student obtains data of relative luminosity λ and relative mass µ for six stars, where
λ = luminosity of star
luminosity of Sun
and
µ = mass of star
mass of Sun.
It is suggested that λ and µ are related by the equation
λ = kµn
where k and n are constants.
